entries.title: Acts 16:1
segments: And he came to Derbe and Lystra. And behold, a certain disciple named Timothy was there, [the] son of a woman who was a Jewess and who believed. But [his] father [was] a Greek.

entries.title: Acts 16:2
segments: [He] was well reported of by the brothers at Lystra and Iconium.

entries.title: Acts 16:3
segments: Paul wanted him to go with him, and taking [him he] circumcised him, because of the Jews who were in those places; for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

entries.title: Acts 16:4
segments: And as they passed through the cities, they delivered to them the commandments to keep, the ones that were ordained by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem.

entries.title: Acts 16:5
segments: Then indeed the churches were established in the faith and increased in number daily.

entries.title: Acts 16:6
segments: And coming through the Phrygian and the Galatian region; and by the Holy Spirit being forbidden to speak the Word in Asia;

entries.title: Acts 16:7
segments: having come to Mysia, they attempted to go into Bithynia. But the Spirit did not allow them.

entries.title: Acts 16:8
segments: Then passing by Mysia, they came down into Troas.

entries.title: Acts 16:9
segments: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night. A certain man of Macedonia stood, begging him, saying, Come over into Macedonia and help us!

entries.title: Acts 16:10
segments: And after he saw the vision, we immediately tried to go into Macedonia, gathering that the Lord had called us in order to preach the gospel [to] them.

entries.title: Acts 16:11
segments: Then having set sail from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next [day] to Neapolis;

entries.title: Acts 16:12
segments: and from there to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, a colony. And we continued spending time in that city some days.

entries.title: Acts 16:13
segments: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was usually made. And we sat down and spoke to the women who came together [there].

entries.title: Acts 16:14
segments: And a certain woman named Lydia heard us, a seller of purple of the city of Thyatira, who worshiped God; whose heart the Lord opened, so that she attended to the things which were spoken by Paul.

entries.title: Acts 16:15
segments: And when she was baptized, she and her household, she begged us, saying, If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay. And she constrained us.

entries.title: Acts 16:16
segments: And as we went to prayer, it happened that a certain girl possessed with a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by divining.

entries.title: Acts 16:17
segments: The same followed Paul and us and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the Most High God, who are announcing to us the way of salvation.

entries.title: Acts 16:18
segments: And she did this many days. But being distressed, and turning to the [demonic] spirit, Paul said, I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her! And it came out in that hour.

entries.title: Acts 16:19
segments: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gain went out, having seized Paul and Silas, they dragged [them] to the market before the rulers.

entries.title: Acts 16:20
segments: And bringing them near to the judges, they said, These men, being Jews, are exceedingly troubling our city.

entries.title: Acts 16:21
segments: And they teach customs which are not lawful for us to receive nor to do, being Romans.

entries.title: Acts 16:22
segments: And the crowd rose up against them. And tearing off their clothes, the judges ordered [them] to be flogged.

entries.title: Acts 16:23
segments: And after laying on them many stripes, they threw [them] into prison, commanding the jailor to keep them safely;

entries.title: Acts 16:24
segments: who, having received such a command, thrust them into the inner prison and made their feet fast in the stocks.

entries.title: Acts 16:25
segments: And toward midnight Paul and Silas prayed and praised to God in a hymn. And the prisoners listened to them.

entries.title: Acts 16:26
segments: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken. And immediately all the doors were opened and all the bonds were loosened.

entries.title: Acts 16:27
segments: And being awakened, and seeing the doors of the prison being open, drawing a sword, the jailer was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

entries.title: Acts 16:28
segments: But Paul called out with a loud voice, saying, Do yourself no harm, for we are all here.

entries.title: Acts 16:29
segments: Then asking for a light he rushed in and fell trembling before Paul and Silas.

entries.title: Acts 16:30
segments: And leading them outside, he said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

entries.title: Acts 16:31
segments: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ and you shall be saved, and your household.

entries.title: Acts 16:32
segments: And they spoke the Word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his household.

entries.title: Acts 16:33
segments: And taking them in that hour of the night, he washed from [their] stripes. And he was baptized, he and all his, immediately.

entries.title: Acts 16:34
segments: And bringing them up to the house, he set a table before [them] and rejoiced, believing in God with all his household.

entries.title: Acts 16:35
segments: And day coming, the judges sent the floggers, saying, Let those men go.

entries.title: Acts 16:36
segments: And the jailer spoke these words to Paul: The judges have sent to let you go. Now therefore depart, and go in peace.

entries.title: Acts 16:37
segments: But Paul said to them, Having beaten us publicly, men who are Romans and uncondemned, they threw [us] into prison. And now do they put us out secretly? No indeed! But coming themselves, let them bring us out.

entries.title: Acts 16:38
segments: And the floggers reported these words to the judges. And hearing that they were Romans, they were afraid.

entries.title: Acts 16:39
segments: And coming they begged [them]. And bringing [them] out, [they] asked [them] to depart out of the city.

entries.title: Acts 16:40
segments: And going out from the prison, [they] entered into [the house of] Lydia. And seeing the brothers, they comforted them and departed.
